title: Small staged ethanol cut has supported positive separation
script:
register lv3
new
new
new
add v1 water 100mL
add v1 ethanol 20mL
add v3 water 100mL
add v3 ethanol 20mL
inspect
distil v1 v2 0.01 stages 1
distil v3 v4 0.01 stages 4
inspect
expectation: Both complete cuts conserve components and recover 1% of initial solvent moles. Four stages enrich ethanol more than one stage, while each pot retains positive water and ethanol.
criteria: Receiver enrichment is comparative, not fitted; no modeled/capability refusal may substitute for this positive control.

title: Pure water distillation is not an azeotrope
script:
register lv3
new
add v1 water 100mL
inspect
distil v1 v2 0.3 stages 4
inspect
expectation: A complete water cut transfers30% of initial water and conserves total water. Pure component vapor/liquid equality must not be called an azeotrope.
criteria: Positive retained water and receiver; no azeotrope-limited event/label.
